name: zinput_mouse_poll_and_store_state
description: zInput::Mouse_PollAndStoreState forwards the dispatch-callback flag to Mouse_PollState and stores the returned HRESULT-like poll result.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly is a thin wrapper that calls Mouse_PollState with the incoming ECX dispatch flag and writes EAX to g_zInputMouseLastPollResult.
BN data shows g_zInputMouseLastPollResult at 0x4e0900 initialized to 1, and VC5SP3 data-symbol comparison for _g_zInputMouseLastPollResult passes with zero unmasked data-byte mismatches.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4703b0 passed via local zinput_mouse_poll_wait target with VC5SP3 11.00.7022 /O2 /Ob0 /MD /Zp4 /FAcs: 0 unmasked byte mismatches after 8 relocation bytes were masked and 5 trailing VC5 NOP bytes were trimmed.
